name: [🌪️DOMINATOR] Tornado Ragdoll Sandbox
desc:
🌪️ TORNADO RAGDOLL SANDBOX 🌪️

Spawn tornadoes, mess around with ragdoll physics, blow things up and cause absolute chaos! Experiment with different tornadoes, weapons and physics interactions across a massive sandbox. No rules, just destruction and fun.

🎯 FEATURES
• Spawn realistic tornadoes, from small funnels to massive EF5 wedges
• Real ragdoll physics: throw, launch, toss and watch dummies fly
• Use grenades, explosives and weapons to cause destruction
• Experiment with tornadoes and watch them fling dummies, vehicles and objects
• Explore the map and discover different ways to create chaos
• Blow up objects and create explosive chain reactions
• Combine tornadoes, explosions and ragdoll physics for hilarious results
• Experiment with different tornado sizes, strengths and effects

🎮 Play on PC, mobile and console

⭐ Like and favourite if you enjoy it! More tornadoes, weapons and sandbox features coming soon!
